## Primes

`nextprime` and `factor` on numbers no fixed-width integer type could hold:

```{gp}
p = nextprime(10^40)
factor(p - 1)
```

The session is shared, so `p` is still here:

```{gp}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
printf("`p` has %d decimal digits and %d binary digits.\n", #Str(p), exponent(p) + 1);
```

## Elliptic curves

The modular curve $X_0(11)$, as `ellinit([a1,a2,a3,a4,a6])`:

```{gp}
E = ellinit([0, -1, 1, -10, -20]);
[E.disc, E.j]
```

Its conductor, rank and the first few coefficients of its $L$-series:

```{gp}
ellglobalred(E)[1]
ellanalyticrank(E)
ellan(E, 12)
```

## Number fields

The field $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt[3]{2})$:

```{gp}
K = bnfinit(x^3 - 2, 1);
[K.disc, K.no, K.reg]
```

Its ring of integers and fundamental units:

```{gp}
K.zk
K.fu
```

## High precision

`precision: 50` in the front matter applies to the whole document:

```{gp}
Pi
exp(1)
zeta(3)
```

## Sums and series

```{gp}
sumdiv(2^10 * 3^5, d, d)
sum(n = 1, 1000, 1/n^2) * 1.0
Ser(exp(x), x, 8)
```

## Showing an error on purpose

```{gp}
#| error: true
1/0
```

The interpreter carries on:

```{gp}
6 * 7
```
